blocks.text: Have you ever wondered how matrices can be used to solve real-world problems like network analysis or computer graphics? Let's explore the basics of 2×2 matrices!

blocks.markdown: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers arranged in rows and columns. In this lesson, we focus on 2×2 matrices, which have 2 rows and 2 columns.

blocks.title: Definition of a 2×2 Matrix
blocks.text: A 2×2 matrix is an array with 2 rows and 2 columns, often written as $\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$.

blocks.markdown: Operations on matrices include addition, subtraction, and multiplication. To add or subtract two 2×2 matrices, simply add or subtract their corresponding elements.

blocks.title: Adding Two 2×2 Matrices

steps.text: Identify corresponding elements in matrices $A$ and $B$.

blocks.answer: The sum of matrices $A$ and $B$ is $\begin{pmatrix} 6 & 8 \\ 10 & 12 \end{pmatrix}$.

blocks.markdown: Matrix multiplication is different from addition and subtraction. To multiply two 2×2 matrices, use the rule: $C_{ij} = \sum_{k=1}^{2} A_{ik}B_{kj}$.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Always check the order of matrices before performing operations. Ensure that the dimensions are compatible for the operation.

points: A 2×2 matrix has 2 rows and 2 columns.
Matrix operations include addition, subtraction, and multiplication.
The determinant of a 2×2 matrix is used to solve linear equations.
